dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: Good girl, Baguette, good girl... Phew.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you busy with?

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: ...Oh, sorry. I'm just... really tired right now. Didn't notice you there.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: Very few people talk to me at work, in any case, since cargo inspection doesn't really involve the crew.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: And as you can see, that's what I'm doing.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: Though in practice, the one inspecting things is my dog, Baguette. I'm just here to take care of her in turn.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mind telling me about your dog?

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: Ah. Baguette is an earnest girl who's dedicated to her work. I'm most fond of her.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: She's got a truly keen sense of smell, and she can sniff out all manner of contraband and prohibited items.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: No human inspector can beat her in that regard, but...

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: Baguette is tireless at work, and just as tireless when it comes to tearing the house down.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only she could be this at peace at home.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: *sigh* See you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me about the "prophecy"?

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, thanks for sending me the Magic Pocket earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: Whether the prophecy is true or not, the pocket remains a very convenient storage tool.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: I should probably stuff all the valuables at home into it. Even if I don't have to move, I can avoid their damage at Baguette's hands.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the prophecy...

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: Please, allow me to thank you again for the Magic Pocket you gave me earlier! It's extremely convenient for storage.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: Luckily, I'd already stuffed all my home's most valuable things in there. When the waters rose, everyone was so busy with rescue efforts that there wasn't time for anything else.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: But I still haven't taken out the stuff I put in, hehe... After all, Baguette can't break what's inside.
